description.value: Powell Brewery is a craft brewery and tasting room situated on Powell Street in East Vancouver's Strathcona neighbourhood, a well-trafficked cycling corridor. The brewery produces a focused lineup of house beers ranging from the award-winning Old Jalopy Classic Pale Ale to the locally inspired Dive Bomb Smooth Dark Ale. Touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver can stop in to sample fresh-poured pints in a neighbourhood setting.
